Generated by tools/figures/tools_readme.py from the tools' docstrings and imports and the CI workflows. Tools check links, schemas and staleness; passing them is not a review and accepts nothing (rule R13). Run by: workflow
· job; +n = more jobs; green = runs in CI, amber = run by hand (see its docstring).

g.text: Terms: 1A–4F = risk assessment code, severity 1–4 plus probability A–F (e.g. 1C) · 3D = three-dimensional · A01–A04 = item-definition validator rule (A01–A04) · CAD = computer-aided design · CI = continuous

integration (the automated checks GitHub runs on every change) · CL-nnn = concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01 to CL-05, CL-05 the reference layout) · DoD = US Department of Defense · F-nnn = system

function in the item definition · FreeCAD = open-source parametric CAD program used for the concept layouts · HTS = hazard tracking system (MIL-STD-882E Task 106; here safety/hazards/) · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD

Standard Practice for System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) · OMG = Object Management Group, publisher of SysML · PDaC = Product Development as Code · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control

software candidate for SUS-A1 · R01 … = validator rule in tools/pdac (R13 = only a named human review accepts anything) · SITL = software-in-the-loop simulation · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-CAD-001 =

the concept layouts document (cad/README.md); its drawing sheets are SUS-CAD-001-CL-nn · SUS-I1 = integrated mechanized walker and observation UAV · SVG = Scalable Vector Graphics, the figure file format · SysML
= Systems Modeling Language (SysML v2) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone) · US = United States
